properties.comment: GP-336, ADR-0016: the roles of people read from the published views of Mosaikit (MK-123). The roles are the identifiers of organizations and teams as they are, which the GeoFence rules of the catalog name (GP-335): an organization for its members and administrators (not its guests), the organization followed by :admin for its administrators, a team for its owners and members (not its guests); ADMIN for the administrator of GeoServer only, never for a person of Mosaikit. Suspended people have no role. Read-only: GeoServer never writes this service, whose write statements are left out.
properties.entry: select count(distinct rolename) from (select a.username as username, m.organization_id::text as rolename from mk_published.membership m join mk_published.account a on a.id = m.account_id where a.active and ('organization-user' = any(m.roles) or 'organization-admin' = any(m.roles)) union select a.username, m.organization_id::text || ':admin' from mk_published.membership m join mk_published.account a on a.id = m.account_id where a.active and 'organization-admin' = any(m.roles) union select a.username, t.team_id::text from mk_published.team_member t join mk_published.account a on a.id = t.account_id where a.active and t.role in ('owner', 'member') union select '${GEOSERVER_ADMIN_USER}', 'ADMIN') ur
